TRA_FAC_RES_B_25: The drilling rig retracts from the shaft, but this only seems to accelerate the loss of material. The dials spin furiously before settling. The resource vaults are empty, drained into the earth. The facility remains offline.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_25: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. Slowly the resource vaults beneath the surface stop spilling their contents into the earth, and eventually begin to refill. The facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_1: My unauthorised intrusion has activated an alert on the control terminal. Its lights flash an angry, hostile red.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_1: Reboot initialised. Data loss probability warning. Offsite back-up detonation initialised.
EXP_FAC_DESC_1A: Security countermeasures have begun a full system wipe. I see file after file being purged from the records.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_1: I forcibly restart the system.<DELAY>0.8<>. After a short delay, the screen comes back to life. All trace of the security programme has vanished.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_1: My attempt to meddle is detected immediately. The system reboots to a blank screen. All data has been lost.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_1: As I wait, the countermeasures complete their purge of the system. The terminal shuts down, its screen a lifeless black.
EXP_FAC_DESC_3: My entry into the facility has interrupted an automated maintenance routine. The terminal flashes a warning message:
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_3: Save failed! Tech blueprint data corrupted! Reconstruction probability: high
EXP_FAC_DESC_3A: A fragmented file appears to have frozen the system. The machine is stuck in a loop trying to access it.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_3: The data recovery operation completes successfully. One by one the errors clear from the terminal screen.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_3: Manually deleting the corrupted file appears to free the machine from its degenerate loop. I can only hope it contained nothing valuable.
EXP_FAC_DESC_4: The facility rings with the blare of an alarm. However, it appears I am not the first intruder. The terminal display indicates a previous hijack attempt.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_4: Virus detection warning! File extracting valuable data!
EXP_FAC_DESC_4A: Strange, shifting glyphs dance across the terminals command prompt. Some alien code is taking over the system's research drive.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_4: The quarantine operation is succesful and the alien code is purged from the system. The alarms fall silent.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_4:
I tap out a few commands, acknowleding but not removing the virus.
There is a short, almost deliberate delay. Runes shift across the display.<DELAY>0.6<> The terminal grants me root access to the facility. The alien code resumes its harvesting operation.
EXP_FAC_DESC_5: The outpost appears to have been in the middle of complex planetary scan. Alarms sound against my intrusion, but the operation continues. I attempt to make sense of the output.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_5: Warning! Interruption forbidden! Sentinel scan ending soon! Control returning to overseer imminently!
EXP_FAC_DESC_5A: The scan continues. It seems to be consuming all the facility's resources, preventing other operations. A large red override button blinks temptingly.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_5: I hit the override button. The scan data is deleted.<DELAY>0.8<> A remote process, detecting the premature end of the scan, shuts down the entire facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_5: I wait, patient. The scan finishes processing and uploads its data. With this special task complete, the facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_7: My entry has caused the facility to go into immediate lockdown, interrupting its operation. Readouts on the terminal indicate some sort of deep-level exploratory or drilling operation.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_7: Geological scan in progress! Medial strata mined. Remote connection error! Immediate probe recall required!
EXP_FAC_DESC_7A: A probe schematic flashes red. Some input appears to be required.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_7:
I hear the whirr of gears and the hissing of metal cable. The facility shudders slightly as the machinery bites into the cable and begins to pull.
After an agonising delay, the terminal reports a successful extraction. The alarms cease.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_7: I try several times to restart the probe. It fails to respond to my commands. Meanwhile, the malfunction alerts grow ever harsher.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_7: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. Alerts and alarms fill the terminal screen, most of them flashing angrily. The terminal refuses to accept further input.
EXP_FAC_DESC_8:
Alarms blare, sounding out against my intrusion. The facility is remotely operated, and no-one responds to the klaxon's call.
The terminal indicates the facility was undertaking a specialised piece of research.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_8: Experiment containment failure. Common fuel element overcharge explosion. Clarify should continue?
EXP_FAC_DESC_8A: The terminal appears to be asking for manual confirmation of its experiment...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, authorising it to continue.
There is a pause, then a rumble.<DELAY>0.6<> Fire belches from the hopper. Smoke seeps from the terminal keyboard. The entire system shuts down.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, bringing it to an end. A small amount of ash is ejected from a nearby hopper.
The machinery hums as it reconfigures itself for standard research operations.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, opening its input hopper. I insert some carbon from Exosuit.
There is a pause, then a rumble.<DELAY>0.6<> Fire belches from the hopper. Smoke seeps from the terminal keyboard. The entire system shuts down.
EXP_FAC_DESC_13: Machinery here is mining a captured asteroid for oxides. The process has stalled. The facility reeks of burnt metal, and the floor is hot to touch. I search the terminal for clues.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_13: Eheu, drill motor automated disconnection! Motor fire! Repair immediately Entity!
EXP_FAC_DESC_13A: The terminal presents a number of repair drone options. <DELAY>0.2<> Beneath my feet I hear the ominous creaking and popping of metal straining against itself.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_13:
The asteroid mining drill bit is replaced.

It remains non-operational.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_13:
The facility deploys a swarm of nano-drones deep within its inner workings. The terminal tracks their progress towards the repair site.
Countless drones perish in the fire, but they eventually get on top of heat levels in the malfunctioning drill motor.<DELAY>0.4<>. Slowly but surely, the facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_13:
The facility deploys a swarm of nano-drones deep within its inner workings. The terminal tracks their progress towards the repair site.
One by one the drones vanish from the tracker. Smoke begins to seep from the terminal controls, before the panel shuts down completely.
EXP_FAC_DESC_10: Security systems have reacted to my unauthorised entry. The terminal barks a series of warnings.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_10: Illegal access! Security control deployed! All goods will be incinerated!
EXP_FAC_DESC_10A: The terminal cycles images of flames. I can feel the heat rising from the resource vaults below.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_10: The flames in the resource vault subside. The facility has lost some of its supplies, but is otherwise undamaged.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_10:
The element stokes the flames.

The experiment takes place, producing valuable trade goods.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_10: I add oxygen to the fire raging in the vaults below. The intensity increases and smoke floods from the resource hoppers. The terminal shuts down, and my suit begins to overheat. I have only myself to blame.
EXP_FAC_DESC_15: My intrusion has triggered some sort of scrambled shutdown. Even over the sound of the alarm, I can hear the rumble of elements cascading away through the pipes. The terminal blinks a warning:
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_15: Warning! Catalyst overload! Circuit board technology overheat warning!
EXP_FAC_DESC_15A: It seems that the system is struggling to cope with the overflow. An automated emergency stop is about to be issued.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_15: The noise of cascading elements subsides. The alarms cease.<DELAY>0.4<> However, so does the facility's operation.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_15: Overriding the security alert immediately stops the alarm. With no reason to prolong the shutdown process, the facility's AI reverses the element cascade and returns system to normal.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_15: I activate the facility's coolant injectors. The cascade continues, but the warnings become less severe. Eventually, they stop. The problem has been brought under control, though the facility is substantially less wealthy.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_DUSTY: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed choking atmospheric dust to clog sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is shorting out beneath my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_LUSH: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed some sort of metal-eating bacteria to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is corroding at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_TOX: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed atmospheric toxins to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is corroding at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_RAD: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed atmospheric radiation to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is decaying at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_HOT: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed the overwhelming atmospheric heat to overwhelm sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is failing beneath my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_COLD: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed the fearsome external chill to overwhelm sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is failing beneath my finger-tips.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_16: Alert! Alert! Power core isolated! Central artificial intelligence core endangered! Hostile environment detected!
EXP_FAC_DESC_16A: A number of recovery operations are available...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_16: I safeguard the power core against the breach. However, vital control systems appear to have been damaged beyond repair.<DELAY>0.4<> I listen to the hum of the powerplant, the only sound audible in the now inoperable facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_16: I seal off the facility's primary motherboard. However, vital control systems appear to have been damaged beyond repair.<DELAY>0.4<> The entirely facility starts to shut down.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_16: I safeguard the control units that house the facility's primary AI.<DELAY>0.4<> With the computer running the facility, the appropriate countermeasures are soon deployed and the hostile environment purged.
EXP_FAC_DESC_18: Operations are offline. A recent research scan has been corrupted, likely by my unexpected interruption. It is crashing every system in the outpost.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_18: Bad data. Sentinel drone activity scan corrupted. System disengaged.
EXP_FAC_DESC_18A: The terminal scrolls through a list of potentially corrupt files. I appear to have deletion rights...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_18: I delete a number of files related to the quadrupeds that guard the facility, but the system remains offline
EXP_FAC_RES_B_18: I delete an unusually large file, a scan the network process that controls the nearby Sentinel drones.<DELAY>0.5<> There is a sudden, large jump in available computational resources. The installation's primary processes begin to restart.
